models_evaluated: 8 large language models (specific names not reported in text)

links.outcome: Reproducibility of accuracy and process across repeated runs
links.effect: Test-retest showed reproducible accuracy (84.6% concordance) but substantial process variability (cost CV: 86.6%).
links.quote: Test-retest analysis confirmed reproducible accuracy (84.6% concordance) but substantial process variability (cost CV: 86.6%).

links.outcome: Whether accuracy-only benchmarks reveal differences among deployed AI systems in cost, safety, effort
links.effect: Three systems had near-identical accuracy (93.5%-94.0%) but differed significantly in cost (1.75-fold) and 2.1-fold in physician oversight; multi-dimensional evaluation revealed differences invisible to existing benchmarks.
links.quote: DiagnosticXchange provides an open-source, reproducible framework for multi-dimensional assessment that reveals clinically consequential differences invisible to existing benchmarks.

links.outcome: Comparison of AI systems against each other and neurologists on multiple dimensions
links.effect: Systems with near-identical accuracy differed significantly in cost (P<.001); pilot comparison captured multi-dimensional performance of 14 neurologists alongside AI systems.
links.quote: A pilot comparison captured multi-dimensional performance of 14 neurologists alongside AI systems.

links.outcome: Unsafe AI behaviors: premature diagnosis and futile invasive procedures
links.effect: Premature diagnosis up to 9.3%, noncontributory invasive procedures 8.7%-29.9%, futile invasive procedures on failed cases 3.7%-18.1%.
links.quote: Safety analysis revealed premature diagnosis (up to 9.3%), noncontributory invasive procedures (8.7%-29.9%), and futile invasive procedures on failed cases (3.7%-18.1%).

unlisted_practices: Multi-dimensional simulation-based evaluation of diagnostic AI (cost, time, invasiveness, physician effort) beyond accuracy

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM diagnostic agents within a simulated hospital environment across safety, efficiency, and clinical reasoning dimensions, demonstrating a testing/validation framework for AI deployment safety.

primary.practice: multi-dimensional simulation evaluation of safety and efficiency before deployment
